properties.name: charge_within_daily_bounds
properties.description: Any valid parking charge is non-negative and capped at 18.00.

properties.name: grace_period_is_free
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: result == 0.0 if args[0] <= 15 else True
properties.description: Any stay of 15 minutes or less must be free (0.0).

properties.name: post_grace_minimum_charge
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: result >= 2.50 if args[0] > 15 else True
properties.description: Any stay over 15 minutes charges at least one hour (2.50).

properties.name: charge_is_multiple_or_cap
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: result == 18.00 or round(result % 2.50, 2) == 0.0
properties.description: The charge is either a multiple of 2.50 or the 18.00 daily cap.
